Lexar NM610 PRO 1TB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen3x4 NVMe Internal Solid State Drive (SSD)

Upgrade your system performance and experience a smoother computing workflow with the reliable Lexar NM610 PRO M.2 PCIe Gen3x4 NVMe SSD. Available at Turbo Computer, this efficient internal solid-state drive utilizes the widespread PCIe Gen3x4 interface to achieve high-speed sequential read performance up to 3300MB/s. It stands as the definitive budget-friendly hardware choice for users and laptop owners across Egypt looking to replace slow mechanical HDDs or older SATA SSDs with responsive NVMe tracking speed.

The Lexar NM610 PRO is thoughtfully designed with a slim M.2 2280 form factor, ensuring effortless hardware modification integration into thin notebooks, small-form-factor builds, and standard desktop motherboards. Boasting built-in shock and vibration resistance with no moving parts, it delivers advanced data safety alongside quiet, low-temperature operation. With its enhanced bandwidth efficiency and reliable capacity architecture, it provides an excellent day-to-day computing desktop ecosystem.
